objects: irreducible components of the reduced base

finding.statement: Component-dimension comparisons across the h^0 jump are not valid over the base generality inherited from C66-GEO-H0. Over a base that is only locally Noetherian over a characteristic-zero field, a nonempty open subset of an irreducible component can have strictly smaller dimension than the component (Spec of a DVR containing Q: the generic point is open of dimension 0 in a 1-dimensional space), and dim Z + codim(Z,X) = dim X can fail. Consequently the step 'X is an irreducible component of the reduced base of dimension d meeting B_3, therefore the incidence over X∩B_3 has dimension d+2' is unjustified, and in the DVR configuration with the closed point in B_4 and the generic point in B_3 it is false: the incidence over X∩B_3 is P^2 over the fraction field of dimension 2 while the incidence over X_4 is P^3 over the residue field of dimension 3, so the jump stratum carries the strictly larger source component and the intended inequality inverts. The pathology needs X to meet both strata, i.e. exactly the case where the comparison has content, and realizability additionally needs B_4 ≠ ∅ (open as GAP-H0-1 / FND-0104), so this is a gap rather than an instantiated refutation. Any node comparing source-component dimensions across the jump must add 'of finite type over the field' (or an explicit biequidimensionality/catenary hypothesis), or state the comparison relative to dim(X∩B_3) rather than dim X. Statements indexed by components of the strata B_k themselves, rather than of B, are unaffected and remain valid over any locally Noetherian base.
